slides.title: ORDER BY = [[line]] lagao
slides.note: Bina ORDER BY ke row order ki **koi guarantee nahi** 🎲

slides.title: Moti salary [[pehle]]
Do [[columns]] pe sort
slides.code:
SELECT name, dept, salary
FROM employees
ORDER BY dept,
  salary DESC;
slides.note: Pehle dept A→Z, **same dept** mein salary bade se chhota

slides.title: Multi sort ka [[result]]
slides.note: NULLs: MySQL/SQL Server mein ASC pe **pehle**, PostgreSQL mein **last** 🤓

slides.why: Pehle **filter** (WHERE), phir **sort** (ORDER BY). Ulta = syntax error ❌
